link.note: Real person (GEDBAS 1420120011) but disproven as John's ancestor: Agatha's father was Joseph Heizler of Munzingen, husband of M. Anna Federer. The tree may have merged him with the right Joseph.

summary: Ibental schoolteacher; round-2 candidate A for Agatha's father — ruled out.
bio: Born and died on the Jägerhof; shoemaker and from 1786 the Ibental schoolteacher under Austrian rule (village teaching was part-time and poorly paid). Married (2) Maria Pfister 1803. His line leads to Josef (1799–1861, Jägerhof), Felix (b. 1849) and Josef Heitzler 'vom Jägerhof', mayor of Unteribental 1919–24.
